levels.definition: [AUTHORITATIVE_DEFINITION_PENDING] E0 will be defined by the authoritative project documentation. This package asserts no interpretation.

[AUTHORITATIVE_DEFINITION_PENDING] E5 will be defined by the authoritative project documentation. This package asserts no interpretation.
No measurement exists. NOT_MEASURED is a first-class status: it is displayed honestly, never rendered as PASS, and never upgraded without real evidence.

rules: NOT_MEASURED must never be promoted to PASS.
No evidence level may be upgraded without a recorded measurement and provenance.
E0 → E2, E2 → E3, E3 → E4, E4 → E5: forbidden without real supporting evidence.
Capability does not imply evidence. Evidence does not imply verification. Verification does not imply qualification. None of them imply authority.
Historical results are labeled historical; current reproducible results are labeled current. They are never mixed.
Every evidence record carries a SHA-256 hash and provenance fields.
If a service is unavailable, the system reports UNAVAILABLE / NOT_CONFIGURED / NOT_MEASURED / BLOCKED — never a simulated success.

Lifecycle order is enforced in code: EXECUTION → EVIDENCE → REPRODUCTION → VERIFICATION → QUALIFICATION → HUMAN_RATIFICATION. Transitions cannot skip gates, and caller-supplied approval flags (human_approved, verified, qualified, force) are structurally ignored.
The public application never mutates registry statuses; recorded transitions are provenance for the authoritative owner only.
